summary: Built the 'My open enquiries' Lead list view: filterScope Mine, LEAD.CONVERTED equals 0, columns Name, Company, Lead Source, Lead Source Detail, Lead Status, Created Date, shared only to group Persona_Recruitment_Officer. Persona_Recruitment_Officer has read-only FLS on Lead.LeadSource so the Lead Source column renders (a person accepted this on #20). This repair answers the latest reviews. The spec uses the single helper at tests/e2e/support/org.ts. The Playwright cleanup deletes only what the conversion created and refuses to delete a converted Account that holds other Contacts. The denial test no longer turns a query exception into a pass. In the agent sandbox: deploy succeeded, Apex 4/4 pass, the seed and cleanup Apex left 0 records, and Playwright lists 5 tests.
